detail.title: CP-UVR-0801L1-4KI3-V2
features: Max 16 channels IP camera inputs, each channel up to 8MP; Max 128Mbps incoming  bandwidth
Support 1 SATA HDD up to 16TB Each, 3 USB Ports
Up to 8 channels video stream (analog channel) SMD Plus
Up to 8 channels video stream (analog channel) perimeter protection
Up to 2 channels video stream (analog channel) human face recognition

General.IP Camera Input: Up to 16 channels of IPC access 8 IP channels by default + 8 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth:  128 Mbps *After IP channels are added beyond the existing channels, the AI Function (IVS,  SMD, FACE) will be disabled.
General.Two-way Talk: Support (share the same audio input with the first channel)
General.SMD Plus by DVR: 8 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle , reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.Perimeter Performance of AI by DVR (Num: Advanced Model: 2 channels, 10 IVS for each channel General Model: 8 channels, 10 IVS for each channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender; age group; glasses; expressions; face mask; beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by DVR: 2 channels (up to 12 face images each channel)
General.Video Output: 1 HDMI, 1 VGA HDMI: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Simultaneous/heterogeneous video sources output for VGA and HDMI is configurable
General.Video Streaming: Main stream: 4K@(1fps-7fps); 6 MP@(1fps-10fps); 5 MP@(1fps-12fps); 4K-N, 4 MP, 3 MP@ (1fps-15fps); 4M-N, 1080p, 720p, 960H, D1,CIF@(1fps–25/30fps); Sub stream: 960H@(1fps– 15fps); D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30fps)
General.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); IPC external alarm output; access controller; voice prompt;  buzzer; log; preset; email
General.Hard Disk: 1 SATA port, up to 16TB capacity disk. The maximum HDD capacity varies with  environment temperature.
General.Recording Mode: General, motion detection; intelligent; alarm; POS
General.Playback: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback (face and  motion detection)
General.Interface Ports: 2 (1 front USB 2.0 port, 1 rear USB 3.0 port), 1 RS485 Port
General.Protocol: IPv4/IPv6, HTTP, SSL, TCP/IP, UDP, UPnP, ICMP, IGMP, SNMP, RTSP, RTP, SMTP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, PPPOE, DDNS, FTP, IP Filter, QoS,Bonjour, ONVIF Ver. 2.0
